title: The plate cooling from both faces
caption: Move $t$ to watch the plate cool, or $\alpha$ to make it another material. The table reads it where W01.2 does; the map shows the whole plate over time.

assumed: $t$ tuned from $0$ to $120\ \text{s}$ in steps of $1$
$\alpha$ tuned from $4$ to $40\ \text{mm}^2/\text{s}$ in steps of $1$
